narrative:
## Handover Summary — Headcount & Comp

Driver and dock capacity aligned with the Q4 volume forecast.

## Key Decisions
• Book the temporary-labour pool for the peak at fixed rates
• Two driver hires in Rouen from November (rounds back in-house)
• Six temporary FTE at Roissy for the December air peak

signals.excerpt: Volume ÷ productivity (7.8 groupage shipments per FTE per day) needs about 135 temporary FTE across hubs in the peak. Each point of temp mix above plan costs about €0.2M.
